newsitem.title: LUXEMBOURG: Cedel Bank reports record 1996 performance.
newsitem.headline: Cedel Bank reports record 1996 performance.

text.p: Luxembourg-based Cedel Bank, a supplier of clearing, settlement and custodial services, said in a statement it had a record turnover of $13.1 trillion in 1996, an increase of 36 percent from 1995.
Cedel Group said customers' securities deposits reached $1.2 trillion, an increase of 18 percent compared to 1995.
Securities eligible for clearing, settlement and custody rose 21 percent, with 92,000 securities admitted.
The bank said it had launched new domestic links for UK Gilts, the Czech Republic, Indonesia and Hungary, extending its global coverage to 33 markets and 37 currencies.
